title: 📖 Lesson

sections.heading: What you will practise
sections.body:
IELTS tests four equally important skills:
🎧 Listening  ·  👁️ Reading  ·  ✍️ Writing  ·  🗣️ Speaking

Work through each question carefully. After checking, read the full explanation — even if you got it right, the explanation often contains Band 8+ tips.

highlight: There are no penalties for wrong answers in IELTS. Always attempt every question!

question: What is a key feature of Band 8+ academic writing?
options: Using a wide range of vocabulary accurately
Writing as many words as possible
correct: Using a wide range of vocabulary accurately
explanation:
Band 8–9 writing uses vocabulary with natural flexibility and precision — the right word in the right context, not just difficult words.

Range = variety. Accuracy = appropriate usage. Both are required.

question: In IELTS Writing, which criterion is worth the MOST marks?
options: All four criteria are worth equal marks (25% each)
correct: All four criteria are worth equal marks (25% each)
explanation:
Each criterion is exactly 25%:
🎯 Task Achievement / Task Response
🔗 Coherence & Cohesion
📚 Lexical Resource
⚡ Grammatical Range & Accuracy

This means a weakness in ANY criterion pulls down your score equally. You cannot compensate for poor grammar with excellent vocabulary.
